evidence.text: Drying and storing outdoor equipment  Dry tents completely before putting them into long-term storage. Moisture trapped in folded fabric can cause mold, odors, and damage to coatings. Brush off loose dirt gently and follow the product's cleaning instructions. Do not use a washing machine or household bleach on a tent. A storage problem is not automatically a manufacturing defect.  Keep sleeping bags dry and store them loosely when space allows. Long-term compression can reduce loft. The product label controls the permitted washing method; different insulation and fabrics may need different treatment. A support agent should not infer washing-machine compatibility merely from the generic sleeping-bag category.  Rechargeable equipment should follow its manufacturer's charging and storage instructions. If a battery is swollen, leaking, or damaged, use the battery-safety process. Generic care advice does not authorize continued charging. This article does not supply a temperature specification for every model, a chemical treatment recipe, or a prediction of remaining battery life.

Check the condition, return window, gift status, and transport restrictions separately. A lantern that contains a lithium battery still follows the battery shipping rules. The recipient of an eligible gift return receives store credit under the gift policy; allocation does not change that credit into a bank-card refund. Original shipping fees and a purchased return label remain separate from these item amounts.

Tent manufacturing warranty  Tents have a 24-month warranty for manufacturing defects, beginning on the purchase date. A stitching seam that separates during normal use can qualify. The customer must provide proof of purchase and clear photos so the repair team can assess the failure. The warranty team chooses repair or replacement after assessment; support cannot promise a cash refund before that decision.  Damage from animals, sharp objects, storms beyond the tent's rating, ordinary fabric wear, or incorrect storage is outside this warranty. Accidental damage can still be sent for a paid repair assessment. A quotation must be approved before paid repair work starts. The repair-price guide lists the fixed fees that are currently published; some repairs require an individual quote.  Customers should dry a tent before packing it for inspection. Do not include fuel canisters, batteries, food, or personal belongings. An approved manufacturing-defect claim receives a prepaid ground label.
